messages:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth asked for a POC demo next Tue 09:30 PT. They expect a short burst of concurrent embedding & chat traffic (~150 concurrent). They also asked that the Dedicated pool be in their VPC for compliance. Can infra provision a temporary burst + keep min_instances higher during the window so warmup latency stays low? :hospital: 

kevin_infra: Copy. Which pool and what min/max do you want? VPC deployment needs private peering set up; that takes a bit. Do they already have a network contact?

maria_sales: Pool: pool-NH-POC-02. Proposal: min_instances=8 (instead of default 2) for 1h pre-warm, burst.max_instances=40 for 2h with burst.multiplier=4. Demo window 2026-04-01T16:30Z-18:30Z (includes warmup). They can provide peering details by EOD. Also want an ephemeral hosted API key fallback if Dedicated capacity hits errors.

lia_engineering: Do we have any constraints on memory/kv cache for embeddings workload? Embedding models keep larger KV per model, might need a slightly higher instance size.

kevin_infra: Good point. For embeddings we'll pin to instance-type gpt-infer-m16 (bigger cache). I'll set instance_type override for pool-NH-POC-02 during the burst window. Also will enable "sticky-cache" to avoid cold-starts.

ophelia_ae: I'll coordinate billing. Can finance-bot create a temporary burst credit allocation & PO link?

finance-bot: action:credit.create pending — amount=USD 3500 purpose="NovaHealth POC burst" approver=ophelia_ae ts=1820456900

kevin_infra: Applying changes. CLI command used:

```
rwctl dedicated update-pool \
  --pool-id pool-NH-POC-02 \
  --min-instances 8 \
  --max-instances 40 \
  --burst-multiplier 4 \
  --burst-duration 2h \
  --instance-type gpt-infer-m16 \
  --sticky-cache true \
  --prewarm 1h \
  --fallback-route hosted-api-key:proj-novahealth-temp \
  --rollback-time 2026-04-01T18:30Z
```

kevin_infra: Also kicked off a VPC peering request to NovaHealth's net team. ETA ~4-6h for handshake. If peering isn't ready we'll demo over a private subnet with port-restricted public endpoint for the POC.

lia_engineering: How will fallback behave? If errors spike, do we route a % or fully failover?

kevin_infra: Configured canary_fallback=20% initially then escalate to 50% if 5xx rate >2% for 2m, full failover if >5% for 1m. Logs will show routing decisions.

maria_sales: Nice. Ophelia, finance-bot, please confirm credits and I'll tell NovaHealth.

ophelia_ae: Confirmed the PO link. finance-bot, please mark credit as approved.

finance-bot: action:credit.approve complete — id=ch_987654 ts=1820456988 notes="NovaHealth POC"

kevin_infra: Deploy-bot shows pool update applied and prewarm scheduled. Quick synthetic ramp reached target concurrency 150 and p50 latency stable at 85ms for chat completions. Embeddings latency p50 ~120ms.

deploy-bot: action:pool.update success — pool=pool-NH-POC-02 user=kevin_infra ts=1820457005 details="min=8 max=40 burst_multiplier=4 instance_type=gpt-infer-m16 sticky_cache=true prewarm=1h rollback=2026-04-01T18:30Z"

lia_engineering: I'll drop a short runbook in the runbooks channel: steps to force rollback, metrics to watch (5xx, tail latency), and how to trigger hosted fallback key.

maria_sales: Great work, team. I'll pass the planned window and fallback details to NovaHealth and include contact for peering. Ping here if peering fails so we can switch to port-restricted demo path. :white_check_mark:
